text:
raj.k: [urgent] heads up — vendor advisory this morning for multiple k8s component issues. ingress-nginx reported CVE-2025-2543 (remote PoC in the wild), kubelet local privilege escalation CVE-2025-3011, cert-manager 1.14.0 has an ACME renewer bug that can leak key material to stdout if KMS plugin misconfigured. need triage + coordinated patch window. @olivia @mia

olivia: thanks. quick checklist: exploit maturity, CVSS, affected clusters, and who owns Dedicated vs Hosted clusters?

raj.k: vendor says ingress PoC circulating (CVSS 8.8). kubelet is CVSS 7.5 but requires node access or exposed read-only port. cert-manager bug flagged as possible secret leakage to logs — KMS plugin misconfig noted. etcd advisory looks lower severity (info leak) but include in scope.

sre-oncall: do we have kubelet read-only port enabled anywhere? thought we set --read-only-port=0 clusterwide. will verify.

mia: running quick inventory across fleets now. will grep bootstrap flags and check image versions.

mia: ```sh
# quick checks
kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{@.metadata.name}:{@.status.nodeInfo.kubeletVersion}\n{end}'
kubectl -n ingress-nginx get pods -o wide
kubectl -n cert-manager get deploy cert-manager -o json | jq '.spec.template.spec.containers[].image'
```

olivia: also we need to consider KMS key exposure and audit logs. if cert-manager ever printed private keys to stdout, we must rotate those keys and reissue certs. forward logs to Sec for review.

raj.k: proposed priority order: 1) ingress patch (exploitable PoC) 2) kubelet flag/hardening verification + patch if necessary 3) cert-manager patch + KMS key rotation 4) etcd low-priority follow-up.

sre-oncall: note: Dedicated customers require 72h maintenance notice. Hosted can be rolling with canary. plan accordingly.

mia: found two clusters running ingress-nginx 1.6.2 (prod-us-east, prod-eu-west). proposing maintenance slot 2025-11-04 03:00 UTC for production rollouts. staging can be immediate.

olivia: 03:00 UTC ok. need runbook: prechecks, staging canary, helm upgrade, rollout validation, rollback steps, and observability playbook (traces, error rates, audit logs).

raj.k: runbook (draft):
```yaml
prechecks:
 - ensure etcd snapshot export and storage
 - export cert-manager secrets to secure bucket
 - run RBAC audit for ingress serviceaccount
upgrade_steps:
 - helm repo update
 - helm upgrade ingress-nginx --namespace ingress-nginx --version 1.6.4
 - kubectl -n ingress-nginx rollout status deployment/ingress-nginx-controller
 - verify liveness/readiness probes and 95th latency
rollbacks:
 - helm rollback <release> <revision>
 - if data loss suspected, restore etcd snapshot (manual review required)
```

deploy-bot: staging rollout started at 1785010200.

mia: staging upgrade succeeded. ingress pods restarted cleanly, no 5xx spike, healthchecks green.

olivia: after patching we should tighten RBAC for ingress SA: remove broad clusterrolebindings, validate minimal permissions. also consider networkpolicy to restrict access to node kubelet metrics ports.

raj.k: action items assigned — olivia: create RBAC audit PR with suggested bindings; mia: schedule Hosted rollouts and run staging validation; sre-oncall: notify Dedicated customers and coordinate maintenance; sec-eng-bot: create CVE tracker and attach evidence.

sec-eng-bot: created ticket SEC-2025-321 and attached vendor advisories + staging logs :thumbsup: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2025-321

sre-oncall: note on KMS/cert-manager: if logs show private key material, we must rotate KMS keys (and downstream certs). will coordinate key rotation with Platform.

olivia: add audit query to find accidental key printouts: search logs for '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' and cert-manager renewer job IDs in the last 7 days. also check CloudAudit for KMS access anomalies.

mia: ran saved search in Splunk — found one renewal job in prod-eu-west that printed a PEM blob at 2025-10-30T14:22:10Z. snapshotting logs and exporting to secure bucket. will start key rotation plan.

raj.k: summary/status: ingress patched in staging (no regressions), prod rollout scheduled; kubelet flags verified on most nodes (one legacy bootstrap cluster needs flag update), cert-manager patched + KMS rotation planned; etcd lower priority but documented. all follow-ups in SEC-2025-321. anyone has blockers?

sre-oncall: will post prod rollout updates and postmortem if anything surprising. :white_check_mark: 

raj.k: thanks team — keeping this thread as main coord channel. will update ticket and close thread after prod rollouts finish.
